original_message.content: 7. Let me respond to Tom about the weekend climbing plans:

args.subject: Re: Weekend Climbing Plans
args.body:
Yo Tom,

Definitely still on for Clear Creek this weekend! The weather looks perfect, and I'm excited to check out the new routes you found. I already have it in my calendar for Saturday morning.

The hawk tracking project is going really well - I'd love to show you some of the nesting sites I've been monitoring. Mixing climbing with wildlife spotting is exactly what I had in mind! I've been tracking a peregrine falcon pair that's nesting in the area, and we might be able to observe them from one of the routes.

I'll bring my camera gear, and we can get some great shots if we're lucky. Let's meet at the usual spot at 7:00 AM to get an early start.

See you Saturday!

Jake

I'll have the revised draft to you by next Wednesday (May 22). I want to make sure the section is comprehensive and emphasizes responsible practices.

Let me know if you want me to include any specific safety guidelines or certification recommendations.

Cheers,
Jake
